## General Principles (from the knowledge base)

| Principle | Why it matters |
|-----------|----------------|
| **Keep movements seated or very brief standing** | Reduces axial load on the lumbar spine and avoids the “long‑standing” trigger. |
| **Use body‑weight or light resistance (e.g., a 1‑3 kg band)** | Provides stimulus for strength without the heavy‑load risk. |
| **Follow the “stop/modify” checklist** – sharp pain, catching, tingling, or lingering tightness = stop immediately [[summaries/session‑01_2024‑06‑15]]. |
| **Integrate micro‑breaks every 30 min** | Prevents static postures and keeps circulation moving [[concepts/micro‑breaks]]. |
| **Focus on neutral spine, core engagement, and hip‑glute activation** | Core stability protects the lower back while strengthening surrounding muscles. |

---

## Weekly Schedule Overview

| Day | Morning (7‑9 am) – “Wake‑up” circuit | Mid‑day – Micro‑break set (30‑60 s) | Evening (5‑7 pm) – “Wind‑down” circuit |
|-----|--------------------------------------|------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| Mon | Seated band pull‑aparts × 12, Pelvic tilts × 10 | 1️⃣ Neck side‑to‑side 2️⃣ Seated leg extension (2 inches) 3️⃣ Torso swivel (30 s total) | Wall‑supported squat to chair × 8, Supine bridge (feet on floor, lift only 2‑3 in) × 10 |
| Tue | Seated “dead‑bug” (alternating arm/leg lift, keep foot flat) × 8, Band row (anchor at desk) × 12 | 1️⃣ Shoulder drop 2️⃣ Seated diaphragmatic breathing (2 min) 3️⃣ Weight‑shift side‑to‑side | Side‑lying clamshell (with light band) × 10 each side, Seated thoracic rotation × 8 |
| Wed | “Cat‑cow” on chair (spine flex/extend) × 10, Seated hip‑abduction (band around knees) × 12 | 1️⃣ Neck/shoulder reset 2️⃣ Small torso swivel 3️⃣ Chest‑opening overhead arm lift (2 min) | Chair‑supported single‑leg stand (hold 10 s each side, use chair for balance) × 3, Supine knee‑to‑chest stretch × 8 |
| Thu | Seated “bird‑dog” (extend opposite arm & leg) × 8, Band external rotation (elbow at 90°, pull band outward) × 12 | 1️⃣ Leg extension repeat 2️⃣ Weight‑shift side‑to‑side 3️⃣ Seated breath + rib‑cage lift (2 min) | Wall slide (scapular retraction) × 10, Glute bridge with march (alternating knees) × 8 |
| Fri | Seated “dead‑bug” repeat, Band pull‑aparts × 12 | 1️⃣ Preferred gentle movement (choose any from earlier) 2️⃣ Seated diaphragmatic breathing (2 min) 3️⃣ Torso swivel repeat | Light “standing‑to‑chair” squat (no more than 4 reps, pause 2 s) × 6, Supine hamstring stretch with strap (no pain) × 8 |
| Sat | **Optional** – gentle walk ≤ 10 min + same micro‑breaks every 30 min if seated. | – | **Optional** – same evening wind‑down (bridge, breathing). |
| Sun | Rest day – focus on posture, relaxation, and any needed mobility work. | – | – |

*All circuits are **≤ 10 minutes** total; each movement is performed **slowly (2‑3 s)**, keeping the spine neutral. If any red‑flag appears (sharp pain, catching, tingling, lingering tightness) **stop immediately** and follow the checklist from the original guidance [[summaries/session‑01_2024‑06‑15]].*

## Detailed Exercise Descriptions

| Exercise | How to Do It (seated unless noted) | Reps / Hold |
|----------|-------------------------------------|-------------|
| **Band Pull‑Apart** | Hold a light resistance band with both hands at shoulder height, pull hands apart until band touches chest, keep shoulders down. | 12 |
| **Pelvic Tilts** | Sit tall, gently flatten lower back into chair, then create a small arch; repeat. | 10 |
| **Seated Leg Extension** | While seated, extend one knee a few inches, hold 2 s, lower; alternate. | 10 each leg |
| **Wall‑Supported Squat to Chair** | Stand facing a chair, sit back gently, touch seat, stand up again; keep weight on heels, avoid deep flexion. | 8 |
| **Supine Bridge (low lift)** | Lying on back, knees bent, lift hips 2‑3 in, hold 3 s, lower. | 10 |
| **Band Row** | Anchor band to the desk, sit upright, pull elbows back, squeeze shoulder blades. | 12 |
| **Seated “Dead‑Bug”** | Sit tall, lift one knee a few inches while extending opposite arm forward; return and switch. | 8 each side |
| **Clamshell (side‑lying)** | Lie on side, knees bent, keep feet together, lift top knee (band optional). | 10 each side |
| **Cat‑Cow on Chair** | On chair, hands on knees, round spine (cat) then arch (cow). | 10 |
| **Wall Slide** | Back against wall, arms bent 90°, slide arms up while keeping contact. | 10 |
| **Glute Bridge March** | Small bridge, lift one foot off floor, lower, alternate. | 8 each side |
| **Standing‑to‑Chair Squat** *(very shallow)* | From standing, lower just enough to touch chair lightly, pause, stand. | 6 |

```
...

16:30 – Torso swivel repeat (30 s)
17:00 – 2‑3‑min seated belly‑to‑rib breathing + chest opening
```

Feel free to shift the times to match your work schedule; the key is **every ~30 min, a 30‑60 s reset**.

## Safety Quick‑Check (from the “Red Flags” concept)

- Sharp stabbing pain → stop.  
- Sudden “catching” or locking of the back → stop.  
- Tingling/numbness down the leg → stop.  
- Tightness that lasts > 10 s after the move → reduce range or skip that move.  

If any of these appear, take a **breathing pause**, reassess posture, and consider consulting a physical therapist.

---

### Bottom line
- **Strength**: Light‑resistance band work, body‑weight bridges, shallow chair‑based squats.  
- **Stretch**: Seated gentle twists, leg extensions, diaphragmatic breathing, chest‑opening lifts.  
- **Frequency**: 2 short circuits per day (morning + evening) + micro‑breaks every half‑hour.  
- **Load**: No heavy weights, no standing > 5 min at a time.  

Following this plan should let you stay active, maintain core and glute strength, and keep your lower‑back comfortable while respecting the triggers you need to avoid.
